cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(tekken6 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set(REXSDK_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/rexglue-sdk"
    CACHE PATH "Pinned RexGlue SDK source tree")

# This file is generated by the pinned SDK and owns the codegen dependency,
# generated source list, PCH settings, runtime linkage, and plugin staging.
include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

# Small ISO inspection/extraction utility; game data remains local to the user.
add_subdirectory(tools/xdvdfs)

if(MINGW AND TARGET rexgpu-xenos)
    # The plugin loader expects rexgpu-xenosrd.dll on Windows. MinGW's
    # default lib prefix would stage a different file and leave an old
    # manually copied plugin active next to the executable.
    set_target_properties(rexgpu-xenos PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
endif()

if(MINGW AND TARGET rexruntime)
    # the netplay code finds its runtime hooks with GetModuleHandleW(L"rexruntime.dll"): no 'lib' prefix
    set_target_properties(rexruntime PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
    # MinGW auto-export skips __imp_* names, but these are actual guest ABI
    # functions, not Windows import-address-table pointers. Export the title's
    # required functions explicitly while retaining normal C++ auto-exports.
    set(tekken6_import_header "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/tekken6_funcs.h")
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${tekken6_import_header}")
    file(STRINGS "${tekken6_import_header}" tekken6_imports
        REGEX "^DECLARE_REX_FUNC\\(__imp_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\);")
    set(tekken6_exports "EXPORTS\n")
    foreach(declaration IN LISTS tekken6_imports)
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^DECLARE_REX_FUNC\\(([^)]+)\\).*" "\\1" symbol "${declaration}")
        string(APPEND tekken6_exports "    ${symbol}\n")
    endforeach()
    file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/tekken6-runtime-exports.def"
        CONTENT "${tekken6_exports}" @ONLY)
    target_sources(rexruntime PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/tekken6-runtime-exports.def")
    target_link_options(rexruntime PRIVATE -Wl,--export-all-symbols)
endif()

# GGPO (MIT, third_party/ggpo: the fork of the PS3 rollback, prediction 3 frames; inputs = XINPUT_GAMEPAD)
file(GLOB GGPO_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    third_party/ggpo/src/lib/ggpo/*.cpp
    third_party/ggpo/src/lib/ggpo/backends/*.cpp
    third_party/ggpo/src/lib/ggpo/network/*.cpp)
if(WIN32)
    list(FILTER GGPO_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "platform_linux\\.cpp$")
else()
    list(FILTER GGPO_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "platform_windows\\.cpp$")
endif()
add_library(ggpo STATIC ${GGPO_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(ggpo PUBLIC third_party/ggpo/src/include PRIVATE third_party/ggpo/src/lib/ggpo)
if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(ggpo PRIVATE _WINDOWS _WINSOCK_DEPRECATED_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS NOMINMAX)
    target_link_libraries(ggpo PUBLIC ws2_32 winmm)
endif()
target_compile_options(ggpo PRIVATE -w)

add_executable(tekken6 src/main.cpp src/tekken6_app.cpp
    src/t6_netplay.cpp
    src/t6_net_state.cpp
    src/t6_snap_calibrate.cpp
    src/t6_snap_store.cpp
    src/t6_snap_workers.cpp
    src/t6_snapshot.cpp
    src/t6_hang_watch.cpp
    src/t6_dumps.cpp
    src/t6_frame_data.cpp
    src/t6_hooks.cpp
    src/t6_session.cpp
    src/t6_pads.cpp
    src/t6_audio_step.cpp
    src/t6_sampler.cpp
    src/t6_net_frame.cpp
    src/t6_determinism.cpp
    src/t6_sound_boundary.cpp
    src/t6_lib_heap.cpp
    src/t6_crash.cpp
    src/t6_resim.cpp
    src/t6_voices.cpp
    src/t6_hold.cpp
    src/t6_watch.cpp src/t6_match_setup.cpp src/t6_research.cpp src/t6_customize.cpp src/t6_name_plates.cpp
    src/t6_status.cpp src/t6_resolution.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tekken6 PRIVATE ggpo)
target_compile_options(tekken6 PRIVATE -mssse3)
if(MINGW)
    # The SDK's SDL entry point is wWinMain; select the Unicode MinGW CRT
    # startup rather than expecting the ANSI WinMain symbol.
    target_link_options(tekken6 PRIVATE -municode -mwindows)  # GUI program: no console window next to the game
elseif(WIN32)
    # clang with the MSVC ABI: GUI subsystem, CRT startup calls the SDK's wWinMain
    set_target_properties(tekken6 PROPERTIES WIN32_EXECUTABLE ON)
endif()
rexglue_setup_target(tekken6 GPU_PLUGINS xenos)
# Profile-guided build of the game code only (build_pgo.cmd): T6_PGO=gen instruments the exe (the recompiled code, the
# netplay code, GGPO), T6_PGO=use + T6_PGO_DATA=<file.profdata> optimizes with the profile. The SDK is left alone: its
# DLLs do not link instrumented and its outputs are shared by every build folder (third_party/rexglue-sdk/out).
set(T6_PGO "" CACHE STRING "gen | use | empty")
set(T6_PGO_DATA "" CACHE FILEPATH "profile for T6_PGO=use")
if(T6_PGO STREQUAL "gen")
    foreach(t tekken6 tekken6_recomp ggpo)
        if(TARGET ${t})
            target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -fprofile-instr-generate)
        endif()
    endforeach()
    target_compile_definitions(tekken6 PRIVATE T6_PGO_GEN)
    target_link_options(tekken6 PRIVATE -fprofile-instr-generate)
elseif(T6_PGO STREQUAL "use")
    foreach(t tekken6 tekken6_recomp ggpo)
        if(TARGET ${t})
            target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -fprofile-instr-use=${T6_PGO_DATA} -Wno-profile-instr-unprofiled
                                   -Wno-profile-instr-out-of-date -Wno-backend-plugin)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
# FMA3 for the recompiled game code (mahmoud-mess/tekken6-recomp, 2026-10-17): the PPC fused multiply-adds (fmadd,
# vmaddfp: explicit fma calls in the generated code) become hardware FMA instead of a library call; -ffp-contract=off
# keeps every other a*b+c unfused. The player's builder leaves -mfma out on a CPU without AVX2 (build_native.py): such
# an exe differs, so the launcher pairs it only with the same build.
# OFF since 2026-10-17 (user: one player base - an exe without FMA3 would be matched only with its own kind; to be
# solved in a later patch). T6_FMA3_ON=ON turns it on.
option(T6_FMA3_ON "Compile the recompiled game code with FMA3" OFF)
if(T6_FMA3_ON AND TARGET tekken6_recomp)
    target_compile_options(tekken6_recomp PRIVATE -mfma -ffp-contract=off)
endif()
# The app sources include UI headers (including imgui.h) and instantiate UI
# classes, so carry the UI target's public include path and object code here.
target_link_libraries(tekken6 PRIVATE rex::ui)

if(WIN32)
    # Low-overhead play/performance launcher. It keeps the best-known ROV
    # rendering path while disabling diagnostic tracing, forced anisotropy,
    # and native 2x MSAA.
    add_executable(tekken6_low_overhead WIN32 tools/portable_launcher.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(tekken6_low_overhead PRIVATE TEKKEN6_LOW_OVERHEAD=1)
    target_link_libraries(tekken6_low_overhead PRIVATE user32)
    if(MINGW)
        target_link_options(tekken6_low_overhead PRIVATE -municode)
    endif()
endif()
